notes: Formatted saved evidence, not a new evaluation or a new Pass/Fail decision.

record.action:
Concurrent generated adaptation near cap
Against the same real-database round-1 snapshot, issue two generation-capable responses concurrently.
record.conditions:
Two generation-capable responses read the same owned round-1 snapshot, released by a barrier.
Real isolated MongoDB; deterministic provider/call instrumentation.
record.expectedResult: at most one atomic write succeeds; final round is 2; exactly two total adaptations and one new response event exist; the losing operation is a controlled conflict, not a duplicate round-2 save.
record.actualResult:
exactly one success and one controlled conflict; final round 2; adaptations/events both total 2
Provider calls during action: 2; persistence: 2 attempts; 1 atomic write.
record.limitation: Two provider calls occur before the atomic single-winner write. The cap bounds stored adaptations, not duplicate generation cost.

record.note: one success; one controlled conflict; both permitted requests reached deterministic generation
